info.title: CosmicForge Community Health System API
info.description: Phase 1: Communities, Membership & Roles, and Posts. Phase 2: Events. Phase 3: Group Chat (each community automatically gets a group chat room via the existing shared /api/chat API — see the `chatRoomId` field on the Community schema, documented in full at /api-docs). Phase 4: Voice Spaces — audio-only, Twitter/X-Spaces-style rooms backed by real Zoom meetings (any active member can start one; one live space per community at a time). Host controls (mute/remove) happen in Zoom's own in-meeting UI via the host's start link, not via this API — the account backing this integration is on a plan without per-participant REST moderation. A social/networking layer shared across doctors, patients, pharmacies, and labs — same architecture for every role, only role/permissions differ. Community roles (owner/admin/moderator/member/pending_member) are per-community and separate from the platform-wide user role.

post.description: Creates the community and makes the caller its owner.

get.description: Communities the caller is an active member of, each annotated with the caller's role (myRole).
Public discovery feed. Excludes communities the caller already belongs to.
Response includes isMember, myRole, and hasPendingRequest flags for the caller.

delete.description: Owner only. Soft delete — the community is hidden from discovery/joins but its data is preserved.

post.description: Instant join. Returns 400 if the community is private — use the join-requests endpoint instead.

post.summary: Request to join a private community
post.description: Notifies the community's owners/admins. Returns 400 if the community is public, already a member, or a pending request already exists.

message.example: I'd love to join this community

post.description: Owner/admin only. Activates the requester's membership and notifies them.
The owner cannot leave — promote another member to owner first (400).

delete.description: Owner/admin only. The owner cannot be removed this way, and you cannot remove yourself (use leave instead).

put.description: Owner only. newRole must be one of admin/moderator/member — ownership itself is not transferable through this endpoint.

post.description: Requires active membership (any role). A post needs content and/or at least one media URL.

get.description: Increments the view count and returns isLiked/isSaved flags for the caller.

delete.description: The author, or a moderator/admin/owner of the post's community, can delete it.

post.description: Set parentCommentId to reply to another comment (one level of threading).

delete.description: The author, or a moderator/admin/owner of the post's community, can delete it.

post.description: Owner/admin only. Set status to "published" to publish immediately (notifies all other active members) or omit/"draft" to save as a draft first.

get.description: Draft events are only included for owners/admins; everyone else sees published events only.
Draft events are only visible to the community's owner/admin. Response includes isGoing/remindMe flags for the caller.

put.description: Owner/admin only. Setting status from draft to published notifies all other active community members.

post.description: Confirms attendance ("going"). The event must be published. Reminder defaults to on.

put.summary: Set/unset the reminder for an event
put.description: Requires an existing RSVP — RSVP first, then toggle the reminder. A background job notifies remindMe=true attendees roughly 1 hour before the event starts.

post.description: Any active member can start one. Creates a real, instant Zoom meeting. Fails with 400 if the community already has a live space (only one at a time). The response includes joinUrl (share with anyone) and hostStartUrl (host only — never shown to other viewers).

get.summary: Get the community's current live voice space, if any
get.description: Returns 404 if no space is currently live.

404.description: No live voice space in this community

get.summary: Get a voice space by ID
get.description: Response includes myRole and handRaised for the caller (null/false if not an active participant).

post.description: Host only. Really ends the underlying Zoom meeting, marks the space ended, and disconnects all participants.
Joins as a listener. Requires active community membership and a live space.
If the host leaves, the space automatically ends for everyone.

post.summary: Raise your hand to request to speak
Move a speaker back to listener ("Remove speakers")

PublicUser.description: A stripped-down user reference — never includes credentials or contact fields.

chatRoomId.description: The community's group chat room. Every active member is automatically kept in sync as a participant of this room (owner/admin → chat role 'admin', moderator → 'moderator', member → 'member'). Use the existing generic chat API (documented at /api-docs) to send/read messages: POST/GET /api/chat/rooms/{chatRoomId}/messages, GET /api/chat/rooms/{chatRoomId}, plus the socket.io events (join_room, send_message, typing_start, etc.). There are no community-specific chat endpoints — community membership alone grants access.

isMember.description: Present on GET /communities/{id} — whether the caller is an active member

hasPendingRequest.description: Present on GET /communities/{id} — caller has a pending join request

content.example: Hello everyone, glad to be here!

isLiked.description: Present on GET /posts/{id} — whether the caller liked this post

isSaved.description: Present on GET /posts/{id} — whether the caller saved this post

parentCommentId.description: Set to reply to another comment

status.description: Omit or "draft" to save as a draft; "published" to publish immediately.
Set to "published" to publish a draft event.

isGoing.description: Present on GET /events/{id} — whether the caller has RSVP'd

remindMe.description: Present on GET /events/{id} — the caller's reminder preference (false if not RSVP'd)

joinUrl.description: Share with anyone who wants to join the audio room

hostStartUrl.description: HOST ONLY — launches the Zoom meeting with full moderator control (mute/remove). Omitted entirely for every other viewer.
